evidence.title: Louisa County halts new crypto mining projects
evidence.supports: Confirms the exact finalization date (Sept. 15, 2026) of Ordinance 26-2, a 180-day cryptocurrency-mining moratorium (or until a regulating ordinance is enacted, whichever is first), adopted via second reading with the third reading waived after a public hearing.
evidence.quote: A moratorium on cryptocurrency mining project development was finalized Sept. 15 by the Louisa County Board of Supervisors, following a public hearing that drew only a few comments from local residents who attended the board meeting. The supervisors agreed to approve the second reading and waive the third reading of the moratorium ordinance, which calls for a 180-day delay or until a county ordinance regulating the activity is enacted — whichever occurs first.
